column2: Transcribed from the feature's eval plan, which is kept outside this repository.
This file is the single source of truth for which criteria exist, which tier gates them,
which implementation phase introduces them, and how heavily they weigh.
tier      a tier expression. "t0" = one tier. "t0+t2" = ALL listed tiers must be available
(the criterion is only fully provable with both). "t2|t3" = ANY listed tier suffices.
phase     implementation phase (spec §13) that introduces the behavior. Criteria from a later
phase are reported NOT_APPLICABLE, never FAIL, when judging an earlier phase.
Phase assignment follows GOAL.md §4, with one deliberate divergence. GOAL §4 lists
C1-C10 against phase 2, but C8/C9/C10 test bind-mount scoping, driver-key selection,
and the enable_bind_mounts precondition — all introduced by phase 3's --division=local,
which phase 2's own description ("no division") excludes. They are assigned to phase 3
so phase 2 is not failed for a feature it does not build. C11-C14 stay at phase 3 per
GOAL: they are t0 criteria over the rendered build-pod manifest, which the templates
land in phase 3 even though exercising it against a real cluster is phase 4.
weight    contribution to the composite. Changing a weight is a spec change (eval plan §7).
